name: Place
description: A physical location — home, office, venue, city, or a candidate listing's address.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name (e.g. 'Home', 'Acme HQ', or a venue name).

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: What kind of place this is.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Loose ties to other things, for what no attribute or relation says: everything about the move, everyone from that conference.

methods.name: distance_to
methods.description: Approximate distance in km to another Place, based on coordinates.

relations.part_of: the larger place it is in (district of a city, floor of a building)
relations.hosts: who lives, works or is kept here

what_to_say: what sort of place it is — a city, a district, a country — where it is, and why it came up in this world
